spans.s: शैक्ष m. A student who studies Śikshā or the science of pronunciation.
शैक्षिक m. One skilled in Śikshā.
सैकत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Sandy, gravelly, तोयस्येवाप्रतिहतरयः सैकतं सेतुमोघः Ut.iii.; 2. having sandy soil.
सैकत (II) n. 1. A sand-bank, उञ्छषष्ठांकितसैकतानि R.v.8, K.S.i.29; 2. an island with sandy shores; 3. a bank or shore in general.
सैकत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Sandy, gravelly, तोयस्येवाप्रतिहतरयः सैकतं सेतुमोघः Ut.iii.; 2. having sandy soil.
सैकतिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Belonging or relating to a sand-bank; 2. fluctuating, living in doubt and error.
सैकतिक (II) m. A religious mendicant, an ascetic.
सैकतिक (III) n. A thread worn round the wrist or neck to secure good fortune.
